blind.description: No text or labels are visible on the model or scene. The model is a stylized square pillar or tower featuring an integrated stepped square base, a vertical shaft, a flared capital, and an open castellated parapet on top. Each of the four shaft faces is decorated with vertical royal blue panels, a downward-pointing sword with a golden crossguard and pommel, and a blue heraldic kite shield bearing a silver/white four-pointed star emblem. The capital flares outward with recessed blue panels supporting battlements with eight merlons (four L-shaped corner merlons and four rectangular center merlons). The surfaces are solid, continuous, and stylized with beveled edges; no shards, spikes, blobs, melted geometry, or floating unattached pieces exist. The model stands directly on its own integral base with the underside sitting flat on the floor plane. Materials appear as hand-painted/stylized grey stone or silver metal, royal blue painted insets, and gold metallic trim. There are no large unpainted or plain black areas, and no flames or emissive glow effects.
blind.from_above: From straight above, it appears as a square crenellated battlement/parapet. Eight grey stone merlons (four L-shaped corner merlons and four rectangular edge merlons) outline a flat square stone roof floor scored with radial paving lines dividing the surface into eight triangular segments. A small dark square hole/recess is visible on the interior corner of the upper-right merlon.
defects: Small dark square hole or missing face on the inner corner of the top-right merlon (visible in tiles C and D)
